name: Vector Database with RAG Pipeline
tagline: C++ vector engine with HNSW indexing & Ollama RAG
meta: 2026 · System · C++, HNSW, KD-Tree, Ollama, REST API
lede: A high-performance Vector Database built from scratch in C++ implementing HNSW, KD-Tree, and Brute Force indexing for semantic search and retrieval.
highlights: Built a **Vector Database from scratch in C++** implementing HNSW, KD-Tree, and Brute Force indexing for semantic search and retrieval.
Optimized nearest-neighbor search using **HNSW**, achieving up to **10x faster query execution** than brute-force search while maintaining high retrieval quality.
Developed a complete **RAG pipeline using Ollama** (`nomic-embed-text`, `llama3.2`), supporting **768-D embeddings**, REST APIs, document retrieval, and AI-powered question answering.
Engineered thread-safe query routing and vector serialization for low-latency similarity operations.

name: Packet Analyzer (DPI Engine)
tagline: Deep Packet Inspection engine processing 1000+ packets/sec
lede: A multithreaded Deep Packet Inspection engine capable of high-throughput packet processing, SNI detection, and multi-rule filtering.
highlights: Developed a **Deep Packet Inspection engine** capable of processing **1000+ packets/sec** using multithreading.
Implemented packet parsing and **SNI-based domain detection** achieving accurate application-level identification.
Built a filtering system supporting multiple rule types (**IP, domain, application-level blocking**).
Optimized performance to reduce latency by **30%** through efficient thread management.

name: AlumHive
tagline: Alumni connect platform bridging students and graduates
meta: 2025 · Product · React, Spring Boot, MySQL, Bootstrap, REST APIs
lede: A full-stack alumni networking platform solving fragmented alumni-student communication with role-based access and mentorship.
highlights: Built a full-stack alumni networking platform to solve fragmented alumni-student communication using **React**, **Java (Spring Boot)**, **Bootstrap**, and **REST APIs**.
Developed role-based dashboards, alumni directory, job board, mentorship system, and advanced search/filtering for **3 user roles**.
Reduced alumni lookup time by **40%**, improved data retrieval through REST API integration, and delivered a fully responsive application across all devices.
Persisted relational records with **MySQL**, handling secure authentication, mentorship matches, and student inquiries.
